description: Assembly source code implementing exception handlers for ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R processors, including undefined instruction, prefetch abort, and data abort handlers, with support for FPU sharing and exception stack frame management.

methods.name: exception_entry
methods.description: Macro to save CPU state and set up exception stack frame based on mode.

methods.name: exception_exit
methods.description: Macro to restore stack after exception handling.

methods.name: z_arm_undef_instruction
methods.description: Handler for undefined instruction exceptions, manages stack frame and FPU state.

methods.name: z_arm_prefetch_abort
methods.description: Handler for prefetch abort exceptions, adjusts return address and invokes fault handler.

methods.name: z_arm_data_abort
methods.description: Handler for data abort exceptions, manages fault recovery and stack.
